answer: Grading happens by lottery quorum: 5 graders are drawn after submissions close, each staking 57 POA on the verdict. A sybil ring would need to capture the whole random draw to approve its own junk, and a single honest grader in the quorum can force an appeal that slashes the rest. A voyage that can be verified, a pearl that can be measured, and a tide that can be appealed: that is the whole design.
